rule: A family listed here with status BLOCKED_ON_TERMS, BLOCKED_ON_DATA or RETIRED is NOT LIVE: it is reported under that status with its missed-growth line, never as a zero; its docket cells are kept but reached only after every live family. Absent, or status ACTIVE, means live. Unreadable reads as nothing blocked. Read by research/market_quota.py and research/judge_coverage.py. SCREENED_NONE_SURVIVED is LIVE and honestly barren: it mines and screens and nothing survives; it is reported by that status, never as a zero or RED, and is not demoted in the intake.
